title: SIM-IE
description: Biomedical Engineering Virtual Simulation & Digital Twin Learning Platform. Developing project-based learning through interactive virtual laboratories, equipment simulations and digital twin environments.

title: SimServ / Code Blue
description: A Unity simulation game for biomedical engineering students to explore medical equipment and service-engineering work in a virtual hospital radiology department.

title: Skin modelling for melanoma thermography
description: A 2D skin model exploring the effect of skin roughness on melanoma detection during infrared thermography, using COMSOL Multiphysics and the Pennes bioheat equation.

title: PAEIS
description: An AI-driven framework for continuous learner modelling and adaptive exam preparation, using response patterns, mastery, misconceptions and examination behaviour.

title: XAI-STEM
description: An explainable AI framework intended to help STEM teachers identify learner needs, personalize instruction and make data-informed decisions through interpretable recommendations.

title: Connector.global
description: An educational ecosystem focused on reducing educational isolation through partnerships, global opportunities, research-backed programs and collaboration.

title: 3D Skin Capillary Model
description: An individual MATLAB project developing a 3D skin capillary model for more realistic simulation studies related to skin cancer and melanoma detection.

title: P300 Speller Data Analysis
description: BCI hackathon project analyzing P300 speller data collected from five healthy subjects using an 8-channel Unicorn Brain Interface at 250 Hz.

title: Virtual Simulation Platform — IBFT’26
description: Prepared and presented a solo project on a collaborative virtual simulation platform for biomedical engineering education at IBFT’26 (SSUET & UTM).

title: GABA Education website UI/UX
description: Led a two-person team working on user experience improvements for an existing education website.

title: Hearing aid circuit design
description: Team-led basic hearing aid circuit design for sound amplification and noise reduction, applying amplifiers, filters and sound-signal concepts.

title: ESP32 Mini Drone
description: A four-propeller 3D-printed drone built using an ESP32 microcontroller and MPU6050 sensor over five months.
